description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a supportive environment focused on delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive team culture. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in overseeing nursing operations and ensuring the highest standards of clinical excellence.

This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000. We are particularly interested in candidates who hold a Registered Nurse (RN) license, bringing a strong clinical background to this leadership opportunity. If you are a compassionate and skilled nursing professional ready to advance your career, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory experience in nursing
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking a dedicated Full-time Floor Technician to join the team at a premier health and rehabilitation center. In this vital role, you will be responsible for maintaining the cleanliness and appearance of our facility, ensuring a safe and welcoming environment for residents, visitors, and staff. Your commitment to excellence in floor care will contribute significantly to the overall quality of life within our community.The ideal candidate will be proactive, detail-oriented, and possess a strong work ethic. This full-time position offers the opportunity to be an integral part of a supportive team, contributing to the daily operations and aesthetic standards of our center. If you are passionate about maintaining a pristine environment and are looking for a rewarding full-time opportunity, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: High School Diploma or GED preferred
Previous experience in floor care or environmental services, preferably in a healthcare setting
Ability to operate various floor care equipment (buffers, scrubbers, vacuums)
Knowledge of cleaning chemicals and safety procedures
Physical ability to stand, walk, bend, and lift for extended periods
